column1: # ARC 3 / R13 -- THE ADJUDICATED CEILINGS OF THE EXTERNAL-TRUTH FLOW
# One row per (leg, isa).  A leg's HEADLINE is the count of rows where the
# tracer drops information a reference states, or where the difference is not
# understood.  The CEILING is the value a maintainer has adjudicated, row by
# row, in the verdict named in ADJUDICATION.  The gate FAILS when a headline
# EXCEEDS its ceiling, when a report is missing, when a headline cannot be
# parsed, or when the leg's scored population is below FLOOR.
# A ceiling is never a target.  RETIRED_BY names the work item whose landing
# must lower it; a ceiling with no RETIRED_BY is one this project accepts as
# a property of the reference, not of the trace.

RE-POINTED AT THE OFFLINE REFEREE.  THE x86_64 STATIC-DECODE LEG drove build/contrib/plugins/isaxcheck, a binary that linked Capstone into the build and was deleted with it, so this row had NO PRODUCER at the tip and read REPORT MISSING -- a red about the apparatus and not about the trace.  Per the standing external-comparison ruling the reference now runs OFFLINE over recorded encodings, and the row is re-pointed at the successor rather than retired: cst_referee.py decodes the recorded encodings offline and gapreport.py joins its opcode word against QEMU's, one bucket per encoding, with every disagreement class arbitrated in gapreport_rulings.tsv.  WHAT THE OLD ROW MEASURED: a reachable-decode-row population probed against LLVM MC, headline TRACER-SUBSET + UNACCOUNTED + HOLE, ceiling 11 over 3,123 probed rows at exec179.  WHAT THIS ONE MEASURES: the same question -- does the trace drop what a reference states, and is every difference understood -- over the encodings the guest actually ran.  The headline is UNRULED encodings (the difference nobody has read) PLUS COVERAGE-PATH encodings (read, and the reference won: the wire owes a change).  Arbitrated-to-QEMU encodings are outside it, exactly as TRACER-SUPERSET was.  CEILING 3, DERIVED FROM THIS READING AND NOT SET TO IT: UNRULED is 0 and the 3 are the coverage-path encodings, each with a written per-row arbitration -- `fild m32int` (the reference's FP_CVT keeps the conversion the wire's LOAD drops), `ud2` (the reference names the trap this encoding IS, the wire names nothing), and `xgetbv` (the reference's NOP is false and the verdict went to QEMU, but the 0F 01 group still owes a word one level down).  NO MARGIN: a headline of 4 is a finding to open.  FLOOR 95000 against 105,762 encodings joined with the reference at this tip.  THE STALE FIXTURE IS GONE WITH THE ROW: the selftest default carried 47 against a ceiling of 11 because the banked root predates exec179's re-derivation; the successor report is regenerated at the tip as part of this re-point and the fixture moves with it per #305. CEILING HELD AT 22 AND THE ROW IS RED.  MERITS PASS AT exec243 (2026-09-18), leg re-run at tip f8cf68784a from a `git archive HEAD` export of tools/, so no uncommitted harness edit is in the reading: TRACER-SUBSET + UNACCOUNTED = 74 over 1,002 facts, 210 subjects, 104 disagreeing rows, no axis INERT, and the negative control reports ALL 9 AXES FIRED.  THE CEILING IS NOT RAISED TO MEET IT.  Every one of the 39 UNACCOUNTED rows was read on its own merits and the wave's attribution of them to the 238-C landing (b012a4a88c) is REFUTED for 31 of the 39.  (a) 17 reg-dst-set rows and 1 ORTHOGONAL row: the tracer names REG_IP a destination of b.lt, cbz, cbnz, tbz, tbnz, bl, br, b and ret, of isb and mrs, and of dc cvau/civac/cvac; gem5 names none.  WITNESSED on this leg's own p_flow exec.log -- `b.lt` and `ret` print RW=[] DR=[], `bl` prints DR=[integer:30] and nothing more, and the whole aarch64 log carries no PC-class operand at any index.  TRACER-RIGHT under R10.  The rows read UNACCOUNTED only because REF-NO-RIP-OPERAND is reached from _x86_dst_label, which compare_insn calls only when isa == 'x86_64'; REF-MAPPER-HAS-NO-PC does not cover aarch64 either, because gem5's ARM mapper CAN produce the name and simply never emits the operand.  HARNESS, not wire.  No vector instruction is involved in any of these 18, so 238-C cannot be their cause.  (b) 8 p_simd reg-dst-set rows -- ld2, ld3, ld4, add v28.16b, addv b29, umov w0, ins v30.b[1] and dup v31.16b each publish an EMPTY destination set.  This IS the 238-C family: the per-TB env interning table fills in a vector-dense block and an instruction whose own range cannot be interned refuses its whole set.  238-C narrowed the class; these 8 survive it, and ld3 is a strict REGRESSION against 2026-09-12 (verify79/r13_V79B), where the wire carried {REG_VEC17,REG_VEC18,REG_VEC19}.  WIRE LOSS.  (c) 9 memop rows on dc cvau, dc civac and dc cvac: gem5 publishes one 64-byte access per operation, the wire publishes none, and at verify79 the wire published one.  WIRE LOSS.  (d) 3 memop rows on dc zva: the wire publishes 32 accesses over 512 bytes against gem5's 1 over 64 -- a cache-block granularity difference, and the wire is the defensible side.  (e) 1 row, msr tpidr_el0, x3: gem5 names REG_TLS written and the wire names nothing.  WIRE LOSS.  SEPARATELY, the 35 TRACER-SUBSET rows are NOT the 22 this ceiling itemises.  fpsr-dst-set moved 2 -> 19 on a CONSTANT 19 facts between verify79 and this tip: 17 aarch64 FP instructions (fadd, fsub, fmul, fdiv, fsqrt, fmadd, fcvt, fcvtzs, fcvtzu, scvtf, ucvtf, frinta, fcmp, fmax, fmin, msr fpcr and their neighbours) stopped publishing REG_FCSR as a destination.  The control corroborates it from the other side: `drop-fpsr` reports DID NOT FIRE -- NO SUBJECT, because there is no longer an fpsr destination anywhere to drop, while `invent-fpsr` fires.  CAUSE: arm_translate_init() declares vfp.zregs and vfp.pregs to insn_dataflow_declare_regfile() and declares neither vfp.fpsr/vfp.fpcr nor vfp.fp_status[], so the softfloat exception-flag write an FP instruction performs resolves to no generic name.  This is an R12.1 loss the clean series took when the operand walk went and nothing replaced it on this ISA.  NOT FIXED IN THIS WAVE: a golden re-bank was running in the same wave and a wire change would have staled it mid-flight.  Evidence: cst_runs/p3/arc3/exec243/gem5a64/row1/.

CEILING HELD AT 1 AND THE ROW IS RED.  MERITS PASS AT exec243 (2026-09-18), leg re-run at tip f2cbe47de5 against the canonical build: criterion TRACER-SUBSET + UNACCOUNTED = 10 over 147 aligned instructions, 418 facts, 114 distinct encodings, no axis INERT.  THE CEILING IS NOT RAISED -- 7 of the 10 are a tracer loss and moving the number to cover them is the edit-to-fit this file forbids.  23 -> 10, AND THE THIRTEEN THAT LEFT WERE RULED, NOT FORGIVEN.  exec241 measured the REG_IP class and refused to excuse it because its rule was unwritten; the rule is now written and DERIVED rather than asserted.  `gem5_ref.ref_nameable('mipsel')` RUNS `_mips_reg` over its whole class/index domain and collects the 74 names it can produce; the wire's program-counter name -- READ from champsim_tracer_generic_ids.h by arc3_cov/wire_vocab.py, not spelled in the comparator -- is not among them, and `REF-MAPPER-HAS-NO-PC` is emitted only where that is so AND the surplus is the program counter alone.  The gem5 side is witnessed on the leg's own exec.log: a JMP lowers to `rdip ; limm ; wrip` and the wrip micro-op prints `RW=[] DR=[]`.  PROVEN LOAD-BEARING: planting `integer:900 -> REG_IP` into the mapper takes this headline straight back to 23 and removing the plant returns it to 10, so the rule is the derivation's and not a pattern.  THE TEN THAT REMAIN ARE THE OTHER TWO CLASSES exec241 NAMED, unchanged in kind: 7 accumulator rows (6 TRACER-SUBSET on mult/multu/div/divu/madd/msub, 1 ORTHOGONAL on mthi) and 3 labelled TRACER-SUBSET rows (1 IMPLDEF-MACHINE-VALUE on cfc1, 2 FPSR-GRANULARITY on c_eq_s/c_lt_s).  Evidence cst_runs/p3/arc3/exec243/mippin/, arms base/ fix/ plant/ revert/ and notes/FIRING.txt.  PRIOR ADJUDICATION, SUPERSEDED ONLY IN ITS HEADLINE AND IN ITS REG_IP PARAGRAPH (the rule it demanded now exists):  CEILING HELD AT 1 AND THE ROW IS RED.  MERITS PASS AT exec241 (2026-09-18), on a leg re-run at tip 3f2fd11933 against the canonical build: criterion TRACER-SUBSET + UNACCOUNTED = 23 over 147 aligned instructions, 418 facts, 114 distinct encodings, no axis INERT.  THE CEILING IS NOT RAISED TO MEET IT.  A ceiling is the adjudicated bar and 22 of the 23 rows are either a tracer loss or a class the comparator has no rule for; moving the number to cover them would be the edit-to-fit this file exists to forbid.  Evidence cst_runs/p3/arc3/exec241/refs_mipsel/legs/_work/gem5cp_mipsel/final/{REPORT.txt,rows.tsv}.  THE 23 DECOMPOSE INTO THREE CLASSES AND EACH IS NAMED.  (1) THIRTEEN rows, reg-dst-set TRACER-SUPERSET, NO-LABEL: every branch and jump now publishes REG_IP as a destination (and as a source), which the three commits at this tip landed deliberately -- 22184a8771 "a program counter is not an ALU result", 272acec6fd "the program counter this wire ships is called REG_IP", 3f2fd11933 "the next instruction's address is not an arithmetic result either".  The TRACER IS RIGHT and the REFERENCE CANNOT SPEAK: gem5_ref.py's `_mips_reg` maps gem5's integer file 0..31, the four accumulator pairs at 32..39 and the two FP control words, and NO index on any ISA maps to REG_IP -- `grep REG_IP` over gem5_ref.py, wp/x86_vocab.py and both comparators returns nothing.  So this is a reference-gap class with a checkable basis and it needs an adjudication rule keyed on "only_trc == {REG_IP} and the ISA's reference mapper cannot produce REG_IP", derived from the mapper rather than asserted.  THAT RULE IS NOT WRITTEN HERE and the rows stay UNACCOUNTED until it is, because an unwritten rule is not an excuse.  (2) SEVEN rows, the MIPS accumulator: `mult`/`multu`/`div`/`divu`/`madd`/`msub` read ref {REG_ACC0, REG_ACCHI0} against trc {REG_ACC0} (TRACER-SUBSET x6), and `mthi r12` reads ref {REG_ACCHI0} against trc {REG_ACC0} (ORTHOGONAL x1 -- the wire names the wrong half).  THE CAUSE IS THE VOCABULARY, NOT THE STATEMENT: champsim_tracer_generic_ids.h has REG_ACC0..3 and no REG_ACCHI, and regmap/mipsel.gdb.tsv states the consequence in its own words -- "MIPS HI is the high half of accumulator 0; reading one half would publish a partial value under the whole accumulator's name, so REG_ACC0 has no value read".  The fold therefore costs BOTH the name of the half actually touched AND the value: the wire prints `%acc0[0x0]` with no width on every one of these.  This is ledger #282's mipsel occupant (a folded register ID has no member discriminator), and it is an EPOCH item by arithmetic, not by preference: the generic space is full (REG_ID_COUNT = 255, ids 0..254 allocated) with exactly THREE holes at 247-249, and splitting the four accumulator pairs needs FOUR new ids.  RETIRED_BY is #282 for that reason.  (3) THREE labelled rows carry over: 1 IMPLDEF-MACHINE-VALUE on `cfc1 r9,f31` (a machine-identity register, not a datum -- the original R13_VERDICT.md 4.2 adjudication, unchanged) and 2 FPSR-GRANULARITY on `c_eq_s`/`c_lt_s`, where the reference names REG_FCSR for the condition-code write and the wire names nothing.  Prior adjudication, superseded only in its headline: R13_VERDICT.md 4.2

CEILING HELD AT 0 AND THE ROW IS RED.  MERITS PASS AT exec243 (2026-09-18), leg re-run at tip f8cf68784a from a `git archive HEAD` export of tools/: WP-DEFECT + RECONSTRUCTION-GAP + UNACCOUNTED = 379 over 40,798 facts and 125 subjects, the same 379 the leg read at exec242, decomposed into classes and each class read on its merits.  (a) 165 UNACCOUNTED, and MEASURED 165 of 165 are one shape: the tracer's set carries a surplus REG_IP and differs in nothing else, on the source axis and the destination axis alike.  compare_wp_a64.py carries no rule for the program counter at all -- the string REG_IP does not appear in the file -- while the x86_64 wrong-path comparator has carried REF-NO-RIP-OPERAND for the same fact since exec33.  The gem5 witness is the correct-path row's: no PC-class operand is emitted anywhere in the aarch64 exec log.  HARNESS, not wire.  (b) 130 WP-DEFECT sys-src-set rows on p_wpmem, 13 PCs, every one an FP or SIMD instruction (ldur q0, ldur q1, add v2.2d, mul v3.4s, str q3, ldr d4, ldr d5, fadd, fmul, str d6, ldr s8, fcvt, str s8): gem5 names REG_FLAGS and REG_SYSFPEN sources of each, because its ARM model reads CPSR and the CPACR FP-enable per instruction to decide whether to trap.  QEMU settles FP access at TRANSLATION time out of hflags and emits no per-instruction read, so there is no such source to publish and the check's answer is constant across the block.  REFERENCE-SIDE MODELLING; a named rule is owed and the ceiling does not move for it.  (c) 36 WP-DEFECT fpsr-dst-set rows: 30 on p_wpmem fadd/fmul/fcvt naming REG_FCSR, 6 on p_wpcache ic ivau naming MISC:ic_ivau_xt.  The REG_FCSR half is the SAME WIRE LOSS the correct-path row records (fpsr 2 -> 19 on 19 constant facts) and closes with it.  (d) 48 WP-DEFECT rows -- reg-src-set 12, memop-count 12, memop-addr 12, memop-width 12 -- are TWO instructions over six excursions: dc cvau at 0x4000dc and dc civac at 0x4000e4.  gem5 publishes one 64-byte store at 0x410540 and names x21 its source; the wire publishes no access and no source.  Same cache-maintenance WIRE LOSS as the correct-path row's class (c), and on the wrong path it costs the address register as well.  CONTROL SHORTFALL CARRIED, NOT BURIED: the negative control reports AXES WITH A FIRING MUTATION 13 of 13 attempted and INJECTION CONTROL FIRED, but also NO MUTATION AVAILABLE for fpsr-dst-set and sys-src-set -- the two axes carrying 166 of the 214 WP-DEFECT rows.  Those axes have no clean baseline left to mutate, so 166 rows are not falsifier-backed and the number is quoted with that stated.  NOT FIXED IN THIS WAVE, for the reason given on the correct-path row.  Evidence: cst_runs/p3/arc3/exec243/gem5a64/row2/.
